repo_notes.content: Jekyll plugin (Ruby >= 3.4) that turns files in assets/documents/ into browsable document pages with icons, categories, and search.

Architecture: AssetsGenerator publishes packaged assets (CSS/icons/JS) -> Generator scans files -> parses YYYY-MM-DD_Title.ext filenames -> bakes icon_url/icon_set/file_type into document data -> creates the documents collection -> JsonIndexGenerator builds /documents.json for Lunr search -> LayoutRegistrar copies the default layout/includes only when the site lacks them.
Key gotcha: Liquid filters don't receive context, so templates should use the context-aware {% document_icon doc %} tag. The tag uses baked icon data and applies the site baseurl automatically.
Key gotcha: Jekyll::Drops::SiteDrop#config always returns nil in Liquid. Config must be read via Ruby Configuration.read(site) in tags/generators, not via {{ site.config }} in templates.
Key gotcha: public_class_method :new is required in LatestDocumentsTag because Liquid::Tag makes .new private. Do not remove.

Text extraction is optional (documents.extract_text, via the plaintext gem): extracted text lands in doc.content with a SHA-256-digest cache in .cache/jekyll-documents/ that survives jekyll clean; falls back to metadata-only content if plaintext is missing.
Quality gates: 0 RuboCop offenses, 98%+ Ruby line coverage (SimpleCov). Run 'rake quality' before commit.
See AGENTS.md for full project context, gotchas, and conventions.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: High-level architecture of the jekyll-documents plugin: generators, Liquid tags/filters, template includes, optional text extraction, and data flow from file scanning to rendered pages

page_notes.content: Include Mermaid diagram of data flow: Generator -> Collection -> JSON Index -> Templates

pages.title: Generator
pages.purpose: How the main Generator class scans assets/documents/, parses filenames, builds slugs, infers categories from category_path, and bakes icon data into Jekyll::Document objects

pages.title: JsonIndexGenerator
pages.purpose: How the JSON index is built from the documents collection for client-side Lunr search, including TextStaticFile with sitemap: false

pages.title: Linking Tags: doc_link and doc_category
pages.purpose: The {% doc_link %} and {% doc_category %} tags in lib/jekyll/documents/tags/: title/slug vs exact path: lookup, text/icon/size overrides, list mode with limit and aggregate, and how resolution_mode warn/strict handles ambiguous references

pages.title: LatestDocumentsTag
pages.purpose: The {% latest_documents %} Liquid tag: argument parsing (count:, category:), rendering, HTML escaping, and why public_class_method :new is required

pages.title: FileTypeIcons, document_icon, and Filters
pages.purpose: Icon set mappings (color/lines/minimal/ultra-minimal), the icon_for class method, the context-aware {% document_icon %} tag, and Liquid filters (file_type_icon, file_type_icon_tag, documents_slugify, documents_title_from_filename)

pages.title: Text Extraction
pages.purpose: Optional plaintext-gem-based extraction (text_extraction_manifest.rb): extract_text/text_max_bytes/text_cache_dir options, SHA-256 digest cache that survives jekyll clean, CLI tool requirements (pdftotext for PDF), and metadata-only fallback

pages.title: Templates and Includes
pages.purpose: How _includes/ and _layouts/ render documents, the document_icon tag usage, and the LayoutRegistrar customization hooks (_includes/document_metadata_extra.html and document_download_attributes.html) copied only when the site lacks them

pages.title: Configuration
pages.purpose: All configuration options in _config.yml under 'documents:' (root, icon_set, include_extensions, strict_filename, strict_extensions, resolution_mode, permalink placeholders, category_map, extract_text), defaults, and how Configuration.read(site) merges user config with DEFAULTS

pages.title: Testing and Quality
pages.purpose: Test structure (unit, integration, system, packaging, and Playwright browser specs), quality tools, rebuilt-gem workflow, and rake test/quality commands
